Queue a Calendar event applequeue journal add <title> [options] Queue an Apple Journal entry applequeue list <journal|notes|reminders|events> Show items still waiting for your Shortcut applequeue remove <kind> <id...> Discard queued items without creating them note add --title <text> Title (or pass it as positional words) --body <text> Note body --stdin Read the body from piped stdin --folder <name> Notes folder (defaults to the backend's setting) reminder add --title <text> Title (or pass it as positional words) --notes <text> Notes body --stdin Read notes from stdin --list <name> Reminders list --url <url> --due <when> "tomorrow 9am", "+2h", or 2026-09-15T09:00 --priority <p> none | low | medium | high journal add --title <text> Title (or pass it as positional words) --body <text> Entry body --stdin Read the body from stdin --date <when> Day to file under (default today); "yesterday" works event add --title <text> Title (or pass it as positional words) --start <when> Required. Same formats as --due --end <when> End time, or use --duration 90m (default 1h) --calendar <name> --location <text> --notes <text> --url <url> --all-day --invitee <a,b> --alert <30m> (repeatable) Global --json Machine-readable output on stdout only --help, --version Configuration Values are read from the environment first, then the saved config file: APPLE_QUEUE [truncated]
